note: MyDesk Animate provides 3D DCC animation, dependency graph evaluation, keyframe Bezier curves, linear blend skinning, and USD/Alembic interchange targeting Autodesk Maya.

capabilities.name: Parametric cubic Bezier animation curves with tangents
capabilities.reference_behavior: Evaluate animation channels using cubic Hermite/Bezier curves with custom in/out tangents and clamping.
capabilities.expected_input: Keyframe time, value, and tangent vectors
capabilities.expected_output: Interpolated scalar value at time t

capabilities.name: Hierarchical scene graph and transform evaluation
capabilities.reference_behavior: Hierarchical transform concatenation evaluating local to world matrix transformations.
capabilities.expected_input: Parent-child node tree with TRS transforms

capabilities.name: Linear Blend Skinning (LBS) skeleton deformation
capabilities.reference_behavior: Deform mesh vertices across animated skeleton joints using 4-bone normalized vertex weights.
capabilities.expected_input: Joint inverse bind matrices and per-vertex skin weights
capabilities.expected_output: Deformed 3D vertex positions at evaluation frame t

capabilities.name: Universal Scene Description (USD USDA) interchange
capabilities.reference_behavior: Export hierarchical transform nodes, polygonal meshes, and camera definitions to ASCII USDA.
capabilities.differences: USDA 1.0 transform and mesh export verified.

capabilities.name: Interactive playback timeline and frame rate management
capabilities.reference_behavior: Maintain project start/end frames, frame-to-time conversion, and standard production FPS.
capabilities.expected_output: Exact frame / second conversion matching project FPS
